title: DolphinDB • Perpetual microstructure
description: 50 depth-5 feeds → Rust → DolphinDB reactive state engine + TSDB → Grafana. Every chart is queried from DolphinDB. 100ms source cadence; 1s chart buckets; 2s refresh.

list.name: symbol
list.label: Perpetual
list.query: select distinct symbol from factorStream order by symbol

targets.queryText: select size(distinct(symbol)) as symbols from factorStream where eventTs>now()-10000
select count(*)/10.0 as eventsPerSecond from factorStream where eventTs between (now()-11000):(now()-1000)

panels.title: Newest event age · detects stalled feed

targets.queryText: select long(now())-long(max(eventTs)) as ageMs from factorStream
select last(spreadBps) as spreadBps from factorStream where symbol="$symbol"

select avg(spreadBps) as meanSpreadBps,max(spreadBps) as maxSpreadBps from loadTable("dfs://perps","factors") where eventDate between date(timestamp(${__from})):date(timestamp(${__to})),eventTs between timestamp(${__from}):timestamp(${__to}),symbol="$symbol" group by bar(eventTs,1000) as time order by time

select avg(imbalance5) as imbalance,avg(imbalanceEma20) as ema20 from loadTable("dfs://perps","factors") where eventDate between date(timestamp(${__from})):date(timestamp(${__to})),eventTs between timestamp(${__from}):timestamp(${__to}),symbol="$symbol" group by bar(eventTs,1000) as time order by time

panels.title: $symbol · microprice edge relative to mid
panels.description: Best-level quantity-weighted microprice minus mid, in basis points. A candidate short-horizon pressure signal; not a profitability claim.

targets.queryText: select avg(micropriceEdgeBps) as micropriceEdgeBps from loadTable("dfs://perps","factors") where eventDate between date(timestamp(${__from})):date(timestamp(${__to})),eventTs between timestamp(${__from}):timestamp(${__to}),symbol="$symbol" group by bar(eventTs,1000) as time order by time

panels.title: $symbol · timing decomposition (1-second means)
panels.description: Exchange→receive includes clock skew and Internet delay. Receive→ingest includes Rust batching/queue/HTTP. Ingest→compute includes stream persistence and scheduling, not just factor CPU.

targets.queryText: select avg(exchangeToReceiveMs) as exchangeToReceiveMs,avg(receiveToIngestMs) as receiveToIngestMs,avg(ingestToComputeMs) as ingestToComputeMs from loadTable("dfs://perps","latency") where eventDate between date(timestamp(${__from})):date(timestamp(${__to})),eventTs between timestamp(${__from}):timestamp(${__to}),symbol="$symbol" group by bar(eventTs,1000) as time order by time
select last(eventTs) as eventTs,last(mid) as mid,last(spreadBps) as spreadBps,last(imbalance5) as imbalance5,last(imbalanceEma20) as ema20 from factorStream group by symbol order by symbol

panels.title: All symbols · p99 latency over selected window

targets.queryText: select count(*) as samples,percentile(exchangeToReceiveMs,99) as receiveP99Ms,percentile(receiveToIngestMs,99) as ingestP99Ms,percentile(ingestToComputeMs,99) as computeP99Ms from loadTable("dfs://perps","latency") where eventDate between date(timestamp(${__from})):date(timestamp(${__to})),eventTs between timestamp(${__from}):timestamp(${__to}) group by symbol order by symbol
